activity.notes: Sima Yi was appointed with Cao Shuang to the regency for the child emperor Cao Fang in 239. His political position changed sharply after the 249 coup, but the reviewed Activity records the bounded regency/governing interval through Sima Yi's death in 251 rather than splitting one representative record into factional sub-phases.
